requirements.requirement: Original visibility of subject to drivers approaching from either direction within 500 feet
requirements.source: NRS 484B.407; A vehicle shall not be turned so as to proceed in the opposite direction upon any curve, or upon the approach to or near the crest of a grade, where such vehicle cannot be seen by the driver of any other vehicle approaching from either direction within 500 feet.
